checks: Verified the only changed JSON field is the statement. Its positive scale makes A a contained homothetic simplex and applies to both profile ranges, so the accepted depth theorem, trace-volume comparison and real section formula are valid.

Checked sources bb78a1a25bcd2390 §§3–5, equations (4)–(9), and 3f94bc936c5d4a14 §3, equations (8)–(12), against their declared digests. The first gives the strict-menu optimum and rational planar check; the second gives fixed-data unbounded overshoot and the weak profile endpoint.

For ε>0 the accepted cover has left volumes (a,Γ,0) and right volumes (0,0,Γ), giving the componentwise residual-root minima (0,c,c). Same-direction substitution preserves the three trace volumes and keeps the whole setwise cover, even if a new left cap touches a right vertex.

The sampled support constraints out of zero give h_−1+h_1≥2h_0. Since all heights are nonnegative and h_0≥c, Jensen for the strictly convex dth power gives objective ≥3c^d, attained only at three equal heights c. Zero supporting slopes are feasible.

With s=d c^(d−1), the two s-valued outgoing multipliers balance their displacements. The derivatives of the height Lagrangian vanish: at zero s+2s−3s=0, and at either endpoint s−s=0. All complementarity conditions hold. The normalized terminal law is the uniform row because the endpoints stop immediately and all three options at zero have weight s.

For z=−t the generator weights satisfy w_−=t+w_+. Positive homothety gives the section for fixed weights as [1−(1−ε)w_−]T, largest at w_+=0, while z≥0 has fiber T. The barycentric minima are 0 for i≥1 and (1−ε)t for i=0. Comparing with b−Lt gives the actual first-exit fractions b/L and b/(L+1−ε); equality gives a supporting null contact. The positive-base interval retains positive residual.

The reciprocal mean is (2+1/t_−)/3. Its strict-range minimum is attained at i≥1 and L=1−b, because 0<ε<1 makes i=0 more expensive. The left exit is then 1/d, giving the closed and positive projections with precisely the specified endpoints.

At a=ρ_d the direct L≥2 trace and coverage check suffices, without extending the exhaustive classification to equality. Varying L leaves the listed volumes, cap mass, source root and KKT law fixed. The menu optimum grows with d and its excess stays (d−1)/3 as a decreases to zero.

The normalized gap is exactly a(2−Γ)/(2(2+a)). The original unmodified row gives (c+1)/3<c since Γ<1/2 and d≥2. In d=2, exact rational arithmetic verifies Q=409/900, total 201/100, c²=5/9, L=2/3, t=1/2, cost 4/3, and (3+9/200)²<10.

issues.exact_defect: The stated inequality 0<a=ε^d<ρ_d allows ε<0 when d is even. In d=2 set ε=−1/10 and T=conv{(0,0),(2,0),(0,1)}, with λ_1=x/2. The actual middle fiber contains (1,−1/20) by averaging a left and right generator point. The triangle from that point to (3/4,0) and (5/4,0) has area 1/80, lies in the cap λ_1≥1/3 and is outside T except for its base. Thus H_(1,2/3) captures strictly more than Γ+a: it fully captures the left reflected simplex, has a null right trace and exceeds Γ in the middle. The same extra middle capture occurs at L=2. The exact profile bound 1/100<ρ_2 follows from (3+9/200)^2<10.
